ANSWER: NO
HALLUCINATIONS: None

The memo accurately represents all key financial terms found in the source document. The memo correctly identifies:

- The 25% beneficial ownership threshold for Change of Control
- The merger agreement parties (Avangrid, Inc., NM Green Holdings, Inc., and PNM Resources)
- The merger agreement date (October 20, 2020)
- The amendment effective date (October 26, 2020)
- The original credit agreement dates (July 30, 2018 and December 19, 2018)
- All lender names and roles (Wells Fargo as Administrative Agent, MUFG as lead arranger, etc.)
- The covenant modifications and waiver provisions
- The requirement for borrower to pay fees and expenses

The memo appropriately notes "N/A" for financial terms not disclosed in the amendment document (such as loan amounts, interest rates, maturity dates) rather than fabricating these details. All substantive financial and transaction terms referenced in the memo are directly supported by the source document.

ANSWER: YES

MISSING_TERMS: 
- Original credit facility size/amount (not disclosed in amendment but typically material)
- Amendment effective date (October 26, 2020) not clearly stated in memo
- Names of all lender parties (memo mentions some but not complete list including Morgan Stanley Bank, Royal Bank of Canada, KeyBank National Association, Bank of America, U.S. Bank National Association, The Bank of New York Mellon, BOKF NA d/b/a Bank of Albuquerque)
- Reference to underlying Credit Agreement dated July 30, 2018 (as amended by Seventh Amendment dated December 19, 2018)
- Specific merger agreement parties: Avangrid, Inc. and NM Green Holdings, Inc. as acquirers
- Post-default interest rate provisions referenced in Section 3.1(b) waiver
- Required Lenders threshold for amendment approval
- L/C Issuer roles for Wells Fargo and MUFG Union Bank
